hook: Tattoo shop owners, quick quiz. *Be honest.*
title: Tattoo shop owners, quick quiz. *Be honest.*

questions.q: Your artist's bloodborne pathogens training was 14 months ago. Still good?
questions.why: OSHA expects workers exposed to blood to get this training every year.

questions.q: A guest artist starts Friday. Does your shop license cover them?
questions.why: Many states and counties license artists individually. Check before they tattoo.

questions.q: The shop license renewal notice went to an old email. Who finds out first?
questions.why: Renewal notices go wherever you told them to years ago. Keep the date yourself.
